name: Explosive Consultation
summary: In Westfall, toxic industry beneath the Deadmines is poisoning the farmland. You travel to Stormwind's Dwarven District to seek an engineer who can supply heavy explosives.

sections.title: A Toxic Source
sections.body: Westfall faces displaced vagrants and banditry under the Defias Brotherhood. Evidence from across the region points to a coordinated, mechanised threat underground. Industrial refuse and caustic toxins foul the soil, and their trail leads into the Deadmines, where an organized operation works below the earth.

sections.title: Seeking Stormwind's Expertise
sections.body: Fortified tunnels and machinery in the Deadmines call for more than ordinary weapons. To stop the poison reaching Westfall's fields, you seek help in Stormwind City's Dwarven District. Roaring forges, tinkerers, and merchants selling blasting powder fill the district. There you look for Sprite Jumpsprocket, an engineer who can devise explosives for the work.

faq.q: Why do we need explosives in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: Evidence from Westfall points to a large industrial operation in the Deadmines producing toxins that foul nearby farmland. Heavy explosives can disable its reinforced machinery.
Alba Fairmoon sends heroes investigating the unnatural contaminants and unrest threatening Westfall.
Sprite Jumpsprocket is a gnome engineer in Stormwind's Dwarven District. She works with complex mechanical devices and volatile compounds, and can craft powerful demolitions.

faq.q: Why travel to the Dwarven District for help?
faq.answer: Stormwind's Dwarven District is the city's industrial heart, with skilled blacksmiths, tinkerers, blasting powder, and engineering components.

faq.q: Does Stormwind's government assist with this effort?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing and the House of Nobles reluctant to send formal military garrisons to Westfall, local defenders rely on independent volunteers and private craftsmen in the capital instead of regular army regiments.

angles.text: As an engineer, you know that brute force cannot solve Westfall's troubles with poisoned land. Disabling large underground machinery calls for specialized munitions and careful technical skill.
As a gnome, you bring technological ingenuity that can help neutralize underground industrial threats beyond the reach of regular Alliance forces.
As an Alliance member, you see how Westfall's struggling frontier communities depend on the workshops of Stormwind's Dwarven District.
